title: Contract fixture case setup
description: The body of POST /__fixture/setup: names a test case by the keys, projects and seeded user tokens the clone was seeded with, and gives it a caller address, faults and crafted reference lists. A setup naming a key, project or token of an existing case updates that case: the fields it gives replace the case's, and the rest stay. A new case needs its caller. Nothing in it reaches the clone.

keys.description: Raw API keys, as a request sends them in X-Authorization.

projects.description: Project ids, as a request names them in the authorize path, or in project_id in its query or a JSON body.

tokens.description: Seeded user tokens, `<id>|<secret>`, as a request sends them in Authorization: Bearer.

caller.description: The IP address the case's requests reach the clone from, sent as X-Forwarded-For. Every limit the API counts per address counts per case; a move is a setup giving another address.

faults.description: Replaces the case's faults: deterministic failures of its next matching requests, in order, answered in the forwarder before anything reaches the clone. Each models the network or infrastructure, not the application.

path.description: Route path after /api, without the query, e.g. /translatable-items.

status.description: Answer with this status, with the error body the backend renders for it; with body, the status the body is sent with.

drop.description: Destroy the connection without a response.

body.description: Answer with this raw body instead of the route's, as something in front of the API would (a proxy's error page, a captive portal), with status (default 200) and content_type.

content_type.description: The Content-Type of a body fault.

delay_ms.description: Delay before the fault takes effect, or before the request is forwarded when neither status, body nor drop is set.

reference.description: The case's crafted reference tables, in table order, which answer the locale, country, dial-code and currency routes once the clone has accepted the request; null for the clone's own tables. A locale-list request that would append the project's target locales (append_target_locales not false or 0, or a project_id) is answered 501 with the fixture's own body, since only the clone holds them. Names are not given: each route names its rows in the display locale through ICU and Symfony Intl, as the backend does.

locales.description: The Locale table's codes, stored lowercase-hyphen (es-es). A display locale the table does not hold names nothing on the locale routes.

dial_code.description: Digits only, as stored (34); the answered name carries it as (+34).

name.description: The stored name, answered where Symfony Intl throws a MissingResourceException: for a currency no currency bundle on the display locale's fallback chain holds (symfony-intl.json), as for und, und with one more subtag, and a one-subtag display locale of four or more letters, whose chains end at once.

locale_code_format.description: The organisation's settings.locales.locale_code_format, which the locale routes key and write codes in.
